formats.key: stake(uint128 amount, uint64 end)
effects: Takes `amount` STONX from the signer by transferFrom to the Ekubo Core accountant (payFrom), spending the signer's STONX allowance to VeToken.
Mints a new veSTONX NFT with a random ID to the signer. The NFT controls the stake.
Locks the STONX in Ve33 until timestamp `end`.
Any native value sent is not used, because the stake token is an ERC20. It stays in the contract, and anyone can take it with refundNativeToken.
formats.shown: Says 'Stake {amount} STONX', with the amount and the stake end date.

findings.title: stake is payable but no @.value field is shown, and native value sent is left in the contract.
findings.evidence: VeToken.sol stake(uint128,uint64) is `public payable`. stakeToken is the ERC20 0x570C…70C5, so handleLockData never uses msg.value. receive() is payable, and PayableMulticallable.refundNativeToken() sends address(this).balance to any caller. The descriptor format has only amount and end.
findings.fix: Add a field {path:'@.value', label:'Native value', format:'amount'}, or state that the value must be 0.

findings.title: stake: the minted NFT ID is random, so it is not shown.
findings.evidence: stake(uint128,uint64) calls stake(amount,end,_randomSalt()). The ID comes from prevrandao and gas.
findings.fix: None needed. The intent 'Create vote-escrow stake' already implies a new position.

formats.key: stake(uint128 amount, uint64 end, bytes32 salt)
effects: Takes `amount` STONX from the signer to the Core accountant.
Mints the veSTONX NFT with ID saltToId(signer, salt) to the signer.
Locks the stake until `end`.
Any native value sent is not used and is left claimable by anyone.
formats.shown: Says 'Stake {amount} STONX', with the amount, the end date and an optional raw salt.

findings.title: stake with salt is payable but no @.value field is shown.
findings.evidence: VeToken.sol stake(uint128,uint64,bytes32) is `public payable`. The stake token is an ERC20, so msg.value is unused and can be taken with refundNativeToken(). The descriptor has no '@.value' field.

effects: Takes `amount` STONX from the signer to the Core accountant.

Any native value sent is not used and is left claimable by anyone.
formats.shown: Says 'Stake {amount} STONX', with the amount and the duration in HH:MM:SS.

findings.title: stakeForDuration is payable but no @.value field is shown.
findings.evidence: VeToken.sol stakeForDuration(uint128,uint32) is `external payable`. The ERC20 stake token means msg.value is unused, and refundNativeToken() lets anyone take it. The descriptor has no '@.value' field.

findings.title: stakeForDuration: a one-year lock renders as '8760:00:00', which is hard to read.
findings.evidence: Case 0 screen shows 'Stake duration' = '8760:00:00' for 31536000 s. The spec's duration format only renders HH:MM:ss.
findings.fix: Nothing until the spec has a days/years duration format.

findings.title: extendStake clears the stake's vote and discards unclaimed voter fees, and the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: VeToken.sol extendStake devdoc: 'Extending clears votes in Ve33.' claimPoolFeesAndExtendStake devdoc: 'pending fees are discarded when votes are cleared.' The descriptor intent is 'Extend vote-escrow stake' and its fields are veId and end only.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Extend stake {veId} (clears vote, forfeits unclaimed fees)', or point users to claimPoolFeesAndExtendStake.

findings.evidence: extendStake is `public payable`. msg.value is unused and can be taken with refundNativeToken().

formats.key: mergeStakes(uint256 fromVeId, uint256 toVeId)
effects: Moves the whole stake of fromVeId into toVeId, so it is locked until toVeId's end date.
Burns the NFT fromVeId.
Discards fromVeId's unclaimed voter fees, because the NFT is burned without claiming them.
Any native value sent is not used and is left claimable by anyone.
formats.shown: Says 'Merge stake {fromVeId}', with the source and destination IDs.

findings.title: mergeStakes burns the source NFT and loses its unclaimed voter fees, and the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: VeToken.sol mergeStakes: `_burn(fromVeId)` after moveStake. The claimPoolFeesAndMergeStakes devdoc says '`fromVeId` is burned after its stake is moved, so claiming first preserves source-stake fees.' The intent is 'Merge vote-escrow stakes'.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Merge stake {fromVeId} into {toVeId} (burns source NFT, forfeits its unclaimed fees)'.

findings.title: mergeStakes: the lock extension to the destination's end date comes from storage and is not shown.
findings.evidence: toEnd = _stakeEndTime(toVeId). The source STONX is relocked until toEnd.

formats.key: burn(uint256 veId)
effects: Burns the veSTONX NFT veId and clears its stored end date, without checking that the stake is empty.
If the stake still holds STONX or fees, they become permanently unreachable, because stakeId(veId) reverts with TokenDoesNotExist after the burn.
Any native value sent is not used and is left claimable by anyone.
formats.shown: Says 'Burn empty vote-escrow NFT', with the stake ID.

findings.title: burn says the NFT is 'empty', but the code burns any NFT and any remaining stake is lost for good.
findings.evidence: VeToken.sol burn(): `_burn(veId); _setExtraData(veId, 0);` has no check on ve33.stakeAmount. _stakeEndTime reverts TokenDoesNotExist afterwards, so withdrawStake can never reach the stake. The descriptor intent is 'Burn empty vote-escrow NFT'.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Burn stake NFT {veId}: any STONX or fees still in it are lost forever'.

findings.title: burn is payable but no @.value field is shown.
findings.evidence: burn is `external payable`. msg.value is unused.

formats.key: refundNativeToken()
effects: Sends VeToken's entire native balance, including any value attached to this call, to the signer.
formats.shown: Says 'Refund native token', with the signer as recipient.

findings.title: refundNativeToken: the refunded amount is the contract balance, which is not shown.
findings.evidence: PayableMulticallable.refundNativeToken: safeTransferETH(msg.sender, address(this).balance).

formats.key: approve(address account, uint256 id)
effects: Lets `account` manage stake NFT `id`: transfer it, withdraw its STONX to any recipient, claim its fees, split, merge, burn.
Any native value sent is not used and is left claimable by anyone.
formats.shown: Says 'Approve NFT {id}', with the approved account and the stake ID.

findings.title: approve is payable but no @.value field is shown.
findings.evidence: The ABI marks approve(address,uint256) payable (solady ERC721). msg.value is unused.

findings.title: approve: the stake ID is raw, not shown as a veSTONX NFT.
findings.evidence: Field id has format 'raw'.

formats.key: setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool isApproved)
effects: Grants or revokes `operator`'s control over all of the signer's stake NFTs, including withdrawing their STONX and claiming their fees.
formats.shown: Says 'Set NFT operator', with the operator and a raw boolean.

findings.title: setApprovalForAll: the intent does not say whether this grants or revokes control of all stakes.
findings.evidence: Field isApproved has format 'raw'. The intent is 'Set Stake operator'.
findings.fix: Use an enum or label such as 'Grant / Revoke', and the intent 'Allow {operator} to manage all your stake NFTs'.

formats.key: transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id)
effects: Transfers stake NFT `id`, with the locked STONX and claimable fees it controls, from `from` to `to`.
Any native value sent is not used and is left claimable by anyone.
formats.shown: Says 'Transfer NFT {id}', with from, to and the stake ID.

findings.title: transferFrom is payable but no @.value field is shown.
findings.evidence: The ABI marks transferFrom payable (solady ERC721). msg.value is unused.

findings.title: transferFrom: the stake ID is raw, not shown as a veSTONX NFT.
findings.evidence: Field id has format 'raw'.

formats.key: safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id)
effects: Transfers stake NFT `id` and the stake it controls from `from` to `to`, with a receiver check.
Any native value sent is not used and is left claimable by anyone.
formats.shown: Says 'Transfer NFT {id}', with from, to and the ID.

findings.title: safeTransferFrom is payable but no @.value field is shown.
findings.evidence: The ABI marks safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256) payable. msg.value is unused.

findings.title: safeTransferFrom: the stake ID is raw.
findings.evidence: Field id has format 'raw'.

formats.key: safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id, bytes data)
effects: Transfers stake NFT `id` and its stake from `from` to `to`, and passes `data` to the receiver hook.
Any native value sent is not used and is left claimable by anyone.
formats.shown: Says 'Transfer NFT {id}', with from, to, the ID and optional raw data.

findings.title: safeTransferFrom with data is payable but no @.value field is shown.
findings.evidence: The ABI marks safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256,bytes) payable. msg.value is unused.

findings.title: safeTransferFrom with data: the stake ID is raw.
findings.evidence: Field id has format 'raw'.
